title.narrative: Soutien à la mobilité des chercheurs et à l'organisation d'ateliers
Support to Researcher Mobility and Workshops

description.narrative: This grant will enable IDRC to encourage five opportunities to disseminate Centre-funded results, support the mobility of MENA researchers, and highlight program priorities. Half of the funds will provide travel grants for speakers, foreign students, and participants to attend the conference "public health in times of uncertainty" (Beirut, Dec 2014). The remaining funds will be divided among the following activities: travel by IDRC grantees to roundtables on entrepreneurship (Agadir, Oct 2014) and on water and flood management (Dhaka, March 2015), travel by a Canadian-based expert on radarsat imagery to train Egyptians (Cairo, Nov 2014), and a joint workshop with the Egyptian Center for Economic Studies (Cairo, Dec 2014). Each of these activities represent initially unanticipated opportunities that complement existing IDRC projects.
